title: ChristmasMobSkins
description: Turn your server mobs into festive Christmas characters!
body:
![mobskins](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ff55e59f2c535bebe2cfa3782aafe12abee184e3_0.webp)
![spider](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/292bdab377a83159da05541a4e3841d5cd5d4207_0.webp)![stray](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3cdb5e49886ade4ff1650b9efcb74cc0aa328326_0.webp)![zombie](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c93c90fba76a6812d11410b4b44fdd81e6ca9ae4_0.webp)
ChristmasMobSkins adds festive Christmas-themed skins to mobs and animals on your Minecraft server.

Mobs automatically receive holiday outfits, colors, names, particles, and effects such as Santa, Elf, Reindeer, Snowman, or Gift styles — all without requiring a resource pack.

✨ Features

Automatic Christmas skins on mob spawn

Works for hostile mobs, villagers, and animals

Multiple festive styles (Santa, Elf, Reindeer, Snowman, Gift)

Per-mob configuration & chance system

Optional snow particles and glowing mobs

Custom Christmas mob names

World whitelist & optional date limit

Optimized and lag-friendly

🐮 Supported Entities

Zombies, Skeletons, Creepers, Pillagers, Villagers

Sheep (colored wool), Wolves (collars), Cats, Rabbits

Horses, Llamas, Cows, Pigs, Chickens, Foxes, and more

🛠 Commands

/cms reload – Reload config

/cms toggle – Enable / Disable plugin

/cms apply <radius> – Apply skins to nearby mobs

⚙️ Compatibility

Spigot & Paper

Minecraft 1.16 – 1.21+

Java 8 / 11 / 17

No dependencies

Perfect for Christmas events, winter seasons, survival servers, and holiday hubs 🎅❄️
